title: CompareSetSummary
description: One before/after pair of drawing sets and how far its pipeline has got (docs/contracts/r1.md §3 `compare_set`, response shape in §7). This is the single object screens A and B poll: it carries the per-side ingest counts, which converter each side actually used, whether ZWCAD is available on this PC, the fonts that could not be resolved, and the frame/pair tallies. A value that the pipeline has not reached yet is `null` rather than zero, so the UI can tell 아직 안 함 from 0건.

project_dir.description: The folder the user picked: the common parent of the two set folders. `.halo/` and `출력/` live directly under it (docs/contracts/r1.md §2).

converter.description: Which converter produced each side's working DXF. Comparing a ZWCAD-converted sheet against a self-converted one is not allowed, so a mismatch is counted here and the affected pairs get `status = "converter_mismatch"`.

mismatch_files.description: Files whose converter differs from the set's dominant converter.

fonts_missing.description: SHX/TTF names referenced by the STYLE tables of these files that are not installed on this PC, sorted. Text drawn with a substituted font still compares correctly, but the markup DWG will not look like the original.

crosscheck.description: Result of converting a sample of files with both converters on a PC that has both (`compare.yaml` `ingest.crosscheck_sample`). Null when no crosscheck was possible.

mismatched.description: Sampled files where the two converters disagreed beyond the ADR-0002 thresholds. Each one is written to `.halo/log/<compare_set_id>.log`.

frames.description: Title-block tally after extraction. Null before `POST /compare/sets/{id}/frames` has run.

unrecognized_files.description: Files that produced no title block on either side.

pairs.description: Sheet pairs by status. Null before matching has run.

last_job_id.description: Most recent job started for this compare set, so a reloaded screen can re-attach to its WebSocket progress.

run_date.title: RunDate
run_date.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`, an explicit input of the compare set and of every run. The engine never calls the clock for it (docs/contracts/r1.md §11); the renderer supplies today's date on screen A and the e2e suite pins it.

compare_set_status.title: CompareSetStatus
compare_set_status.description: Pipeline stage: `ingesting` -> `ingested` -> `extracting` -> `matched` -> `comparing` -> `compared`, with `exporting` returning to `compared`. `failed` is terminal until the user restarts (docs/contracts/r1.md §3).

converter_name.title: ConverterName
converter_name.description: `zwcad-com` the background ZWCAD instance (the production path), `mlightcad-dxfout` the desktop's own writer, `acad-ts` the Node CLI fallback (ADR-0002).

set_side.title: CompareSetSide
set_side.description: Ingest tally for one of the two drawing sets.

dir.description: Absolute path of the set folder the user picked. Read-only for the whole app (CLAUDE.md rule 1).

label.description: Folder name, used in the output file name `<도면번호>_<후 라벨>_markup.dwg`.

files.description: Drawings found in the folder, excluded ones included.

zwcad_status.title: ZwcadStatus
zwcad_status.description: Whether this process can convert with ZWCAD right now (docs/contracts/r1.md §6.1, `compare/zwcad.py` `detect()`). Also the body of `GET /compare/zwcad/status`. On macOS and Linux `available` is always false with `reason = "not_windows"`.

available.description: Windows + comtypes + a registered ProgID, verified by actually creating the COM object.

installed.description: ZWCAD appears to be installed, even if this process cannot drive it.

prog_id.description: `ZWCAD.Application`, or the version-suffixed ProgID that was found.

reason.description: Machine-readable cause when `available` is false. The UI turns it into Korean via `zwcad.reason.*`; the code itself is never translated.
